title: ComposerPrefs
description: composer.prefs@1: a person's composer settings, the same on every OpenVibe site because Network stores them (GET/PUT /api/v1/me/composer). `rev` is the stored revision: send the one you read back with your change, and a tab that read an older copy gets 409 with the current document instead of overwriting the other tab. `send_key` says whether Enter or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends. `tools` is the one order of the composer's tools and which are hidden; a tool id the client does not know is kept, so a site can add one without another site dropping the person's order. `snippets` are the person's saved inserts, triggered by typing a slash word.

rev.description: Revision of the stored document. A missing document is rev 0 with the defaults; every successful PUT answers rev + 1.

send_key.description: enter: Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks the line. mod-enter: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends and Enter breaks the line (the default on a phone keyboard is enter).

tools.description: Every tool in the order the person wants them, each marked hidden or not.

density.description: How much room the composer takes: comfy is the default on a computer, compact on a phone.

voice.description: Whether the composer offers dictation (where the device has it).

snippets.description: Saved inserts. Typing the trigger (a slash word such as /sig) in the composer offers the snippet.

trigger.description: The slash word that offers the snippet, e.g. /sig. Lower-case letters, digits, _ and - only.
